original_finding_content.subject: Quora ES — multiple blocked URLs with uncertain or affiliate-only roles
original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** Multiple Quora ES answers about Hotmart experience found in search snippets but URLs blocked by robots.txt; of those with visible snippets, most are affiliate perspectives, not producer/seller.  
**Verbatim snippet:** n/a — consolidated absence/exclusion finding  
**Source:** Searches: `site:quora.com hotmart experiencia vendedor español`; URLs blocked include https://es.quora.com/Experiencia-Como-Afiliado-de-Marketing-en-HotMart-Un-Relato-Personal (affiliate, not producer); https://es.quora.com/Alguien-con-alguna-experiencia-positiva-o-negativa-trabajando-con-Hotmart (role uncertain); https://es.quora.com/Cómo-vender-por-Marketplace-paso-a-paso (self-identified "Super Afiliado," $5K/month — affiliate, not producer).  
**Notes:** Quora answers consistently blocked by robots.txt. Snippets visible in search results only. Most identified speakers are affiliates, not product creators/producers — excluded per scope ("not affiliate marketing without substantive seller experience"). One producer voice captured as F-P01.
